name: rewind-fork-insteadof-guard
description: The rewind/fork origin guard (lib/apps/fabro-cli/src/shared/repo.rs, ensure_matching_repo_origin) resolves git url.<replacement>.insteadOf rewrites in BOTH directions before comparing normalized origin URLs: forward (git semantics) and inverse (recovering the canonical form for alias-stored origins). Keep rewrite_candidates() bidirectional and insteadof_rewrites() multi-value (git2 Config::entries glob 'url.*.insteadof' matches dotted alias keys; every value of a key yields its own pair). Verified live with denkhaus.github.com alias + multi-value rewrites (PR fabro-sh/fabro#773, commit 009dc6878).

name: manifest-insteadof-canonicalization
description: Repo-origin detection now canonicalizes insteadOf aliases end-to-end: fabro_github::canonicalize_repo_origin_url (pure, fabro-github next to normalize_repo_origin_url) + fabro_manifest::insteadof_rewrites(&repo) (git2 config cascade, multi-value keys). detect_manifest_repo_info applies both before normalizing, so alias-host checkouts (multi-account SSH setups) store canonical github.com URLs in manifests without a [run.scm] pin. Direction rule: alias-stored origins recover the pre-rewrite matcher form; canonically stored origins stay unchanged (git rewrites at fetch time). The rewind/fork guard (shared/repo.rs) uses the same shared helpers — keep them in sync when touching either (commits 009dc6878 + 16bbb8bfb, upstream PRs #773 + follow-up candidate).

name: server-image-skew-debugging
description: docker-compose.yaml defaulted FABRO_VERSION to public 'nightly' while just build-image tags ghcr.io/fabro-sh/fabro:local — a fresh just up recreated the container from a CACHED public nightly (0.331) instead of the local build (0.335); the CLI/server skew surfaced as 'Failed to parse run config TOML' on newer config keys ([run.pull_request] model). Always verify BOTH sides with fabro version (Client + Server Build Date) after just up; compose default is now 'local' (34faf268a).

Two cargo-test hang classes this session: (1) first full build of fabro-server after a 36-commit upstream merge while disk at 91% and load ~6 — tool-call timeout aborts but cargo keeps running in background; check ps aux for leftover rustc before retrying, re-run is fast (warm cache). (2) NEVER conclude a hang without solo-vs-suite comparison: env-leak failures (FABRO_TEST_IN_MEMORY_STORE) and missing-helper failures (SVG tests needing target/debug/fabro binary) pass solo and fail in suite — that signature points at test pollution, not your diff.
resolution: Before green-suite gates: cargo build -p fabro-cli --bin fabro (SVG render tests spawn it); treat solo-pass/suite-fail as pollution and hunt process-wide env; on tool timeout check leftover compilers before assuming deadlock.

description: fabro ask prints the answer twice in text mode: render_event (commands/run/ask.rs) prints every assistant_delta AND afterwards the full assistant_message again. Reproduced: ask with 'reply exactly ECHO9T' outputs ECHO9TECHO9T regardless of --quiet/tty. Workaround until fixed: parse the JSONL run.session.turn.succeeded event (--json) — scripts/run_workflow.nu does this. Fix direction: track whether deltas were rendered; skip the assistant_message println then (attach.rs already gates correctly). Seed: fabro-bd6c.
